module vending_machine (
    input clk, reset,
    input coin_inserted, item_selected,
    output [1:0] state
);

reg [1:0] state;
reg [1:0] next_state;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        state <= 2'b00;
    else
        state <= next_state;
end

always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        2'b00: begin // Reset state
            if (coin_inserted) next_state = 2'b01; // Selected state
            else next_state = 2'b00; // Stay in reset
        end
        2'b01: begin // Selected state
            if (item_selected) next_state = 2'b00; // Sold state
            else next_state = 2'b10; // Error state
        end
        2'b10: begin // Error state
            if (coin_inserted) next_state = 2'b01; // Retry state
            else next_state = 2'b10; // Stay in error
        end
        default: next_state = 2'b00;
    endcase
end

assign state = state;

endmodule

module subtract_8bit (
    input signed [7:0] a, b,
    output signed [8:0] diff
);
    wire [7:0] not_b;       // Two's complement of b
    wire carry_in;          // Carry-in for the most significant bit (equals 1)

    not_b[7:0] = ~(b[7:0]); // Invert each bit of b
    diff      = a[7:0] + not_b[7:0] + {1'b1, 8'b0}; // Add with carry-in of 1

    assign carry_in = diff[8]; // The 9th bit of the result is the carry-out for the MSB subtraction

endmodule

module priority_encoder_4to2 (
    input  [3:0] in,
    output [1:0] out,
    output       valid
);

            case (1)
                in[3]: out = 2'b11; // Decimal 3
                in[2]: out = 2'b10; // Decimal 2
                in[1]: out = 2'b01; // Decimal 1
                in[0]: out = 2'b00; // Decimal 0
                default: out = 2'b00;
            endcase
        end else begin
            out = 2'b00; // No active inputs, output 00
        end
    end

endmodule

        endcase
    end

module parallel2serial(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input [3:0] d,
    output valid_out,
    output dout
);

    reg [3:0] shift_reg; // 4-bit shift register to hold the data
    reg [3:0] count;     // Counter to track how many bits we've shifted
    reg valid_flop;      // Flipflop to hold the output valid signal

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            shift_reg <= {4'b0000}; // Reset shift register to 0
            count <= 4'b0000;         // Reset counter
            valid_flop <= 1'b0;      // Reset valid signal
            dout <= 1'b0;            // Reset output data
        end
        else begin
            // Load parallel data if all bits in shift_reg are 0 (leftmost 4 bits used every cycle)
            if (shift_reg == 4'd0) 
                shift_reg <= d;       // Load new parallel data
        
            // Shift out one bit on every clock cycle
            dout <= shift_reg[0];         // Output the least significant bit
            shift_reg <= {shift_reg[3:1], 1'b0}; 

            count <= count + 4'b1;         // Increment the counter

            // Set the valid signal after the first bit shifts out
            valid_flop <= (count >= 4'd3) ? 1'b1 : count[0]; // Start valid 
            dout <= shift_reg[0];
        end
    end

    assign valid_out = valid_flop;

endmodule
